title: A pullback stable at later stages is preserved in the category colimit
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category, $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories, and $V$ a cocone of $F$. Its object and arrow set cocones [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor] are colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Fix $j\in J$ and arrows $f:Y\to X$ and $g:Z\to X$ in $F(j)$ whose pullback exists. Suppose every transition functor $F(a)$ for $a:j\to k$ preserves this pullback. Then the cocone functor $V_j:F(j)\to V.pt$ preserves this pullback.

source.place: Tag 09YL (lemma-colimit-sites), pullback paragraph and displayed Hom calculation; consulted at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09YL

proof.text: Every cone over the image cospan admits a factorizing arrow by finite stage lifting and the preserved stage pullback universal property.
The two image projections are jointly monic by lifting two proposed mediating arrows and enforcing their projection equalities at a later stage.
Use existence and joint monicity to construct the IsLimit witness for the mapped pullback cone. Transfer through isLimitMapConeEquiv, then apply preservesLimit_of_preserves_limit_cone.

lean.statement:
theorem filteredColimit_preservesPullback
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (j : J) {X Y Z : F.obj j} (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X) [HasPullback f g]
    (hpres : ∀ (k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map a).toFunctor) :
    PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (V.ι.app j).toFunctor
